change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Clearer setting names: the item's Bento Size is bento_size (was size) and Toolbar Alignment is toolbar_align (was filter_align). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.
The Load More label can only be set when Items Shown First is set, and Toolbar Alignment only with the filter or search on.
The filter buttons group is named for screen readers ("Filter by tag", from the language files).

fix.item: Title HTML Element only accepts h1-h6 and div (h1, h5 and h6 added to the list).
The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.

addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, meta text, content, image and link of all items without deleting them.

change.item: Labels shown to visitors (All, Search, Load more, no results) come from the plugin's language files (English and Malay), so other languages can be added with Joomla's Language Overrides. The element's own label fields still take priority.

addition.item: First release: grid, masonry or bento layouts (wide, tall and large items), columns per screen size and a swipe carousel on phones. A tag filter with animated reordering, a search box and a Load more button. Cards with the text below or over the image, and zoom, lift or tilt on hover. Items can come from dynamic content, e.g. one per article with its tags as filters.
